instructions: Review this TypeScript monorepo for correctness, security, data integrity, protocol compatibility, and test coverage. Report only concrete, actionable findings; do not report style-only preferences already handled by formatters or linters.

rules.rule: Keep poker-engine deterministic and pure: no network, database, UI, framework, clock, or non-injectable randomness dependencies. Rule changes must preserve card uniqueness and chip conservation.
Changes to betting, all-in, side-pot, split-pot, hand evaluation, or state transitions require focused tests covering normal and edge cases.
Protocol runtime schemas are the only source of wire types. Preserve protocol versioning, tableId, handId, monotonic event sequencing, commandId idempotency, and backward compatibility.
Treat all client input as untrusted. The server must remain authoritative for game state and validate authorization, legal actions, expected sequence, and idempotency before mutation.
Persistence changes must preserve transaction atomicity, auditability, replay/recovery semantics, and protection of credentials or player data.
The web client may render server projections and submit commands, but must not independently resolve poker outcomes or expose data unavailable to the player view.
GitHub workflow changes must use least-privilege permissions, avoid secrets in logs, and preserve required checks and protected-branch policy.
Do not commit API keys, tokens, credentials, real player data, or sensitive operational logs. New configuration must use environment references and documented non-secret examples.
